title: Branding agency showreel: rapid-fire logo/identity case-study montage
summary: A ~25 s agency showreel (then ~10 s of black tail) cutting through dozens of identity projects: logo marks animating on flat brand-colour fields, merch and print photography, website hero sections, a search-bar UI typing, and monoline icon + word animations ('EXPLORE', 'P-L-A-N', 'AND ✓'). Every 0.1-1.5 s is a new brand world; the rhythm is the point.
fit_reason: Too frantic as a whole for B2B, but the monoline icon-draw + letter-on-a-line micro animations and flat colour logo cards are clean, premium and reusable for feature stings.

palette.mood: high-contrast mix: each brand on its own flat colour (olive, teal, ultramarine, forest green, acid yellow) against white/black

typography.display: mix per brand; recurring bold geometric grotesk caps (EXPLORE, AND), custom display logotypes (M->TAPHOR), editorial serifs on print pieces
typography.case: upper for labels; sentence in UI/editorial
typography.size_behaviour: huge logotypes filling width, or small spaced caps in the micro-animations
typography.notes: Micro-type moments use widely spaced caps on a thin black baseline that bends into steps between letters.

text_animation: letters drop/settle onto a baseline one at a time (EXPLORE)
baseline line draws through spaced letters with step bends (P_L_A_N)
logotype snaps on with pixel/dither glitch
transitions: hard cut on beat (very fast bursts of 0.1-0.2 s)
ui_treatment: flat browser/website mockups and a search bar on white, full-frame

sound.sync: cuts locked to beat, bursts on fills

signature_moves: one brand per beat on its own flat colour
monoline icon + bold caps word micro-animations on white
thin line that steps between letters and carries into the next shot

best_segments.what: EXPLORE compass draw, P-L-A-N stepped line, AND -> check: monoline micro-animation on white

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP: SVG icons with stroke-dashoffset draw, spaced caps with per-letter y drop, an SVG path that steps between letters; colour-field cards cut on a beat grid in Remotion.
recreate.prompt: Clean agency showreel: bold geometric caps and monoline icons drawing on white, a thin black line stepping between spaced letters and leading into the next shot, interspersed with logos on flat brand-colour fields cut on the beat.
